name: app-smoke-sample
description: Replace this sample with the project's release smoke test points.
globalChecks: No crash, frozen screen, infinite loading, obvious layout overlap, or blank WebView.
Important text is readable and controls respond within a reasonable time.
Unexpected permission, upgrade, login-expired, or network-error dialogs are reported.

steps.title: Launch app and handle entry blockers
steps.objective: Start the app from a clean foreground state and pass system/app permission prompts that block smoke testing.
steps.action: Launch the app. If permission dialogs, privacy agreements, update reminders, or onboarding overlays appear, choose the option that lets QA continue without granting unnecessary permissions.
steps.expected: The app reaches the login page or home page and is ready for smoke testing.

steps.title: Login when session is absent
steps.objective: Use the configured QA account if the app is not already logged in.
steps.action: If a login screen is visible, enter the QA username and password from the test data or environment notes, then submit. If already logged in, do not log out.
steps.expected: The app is authenticated and shows the main/home experience.

steps.title: Home screen basic health
steps.objective: Confirm the primary home screen is visually usable.
steps.action: Inspect the home screen. Close non-critical popups only when they cover the main workflow.
steps.expected: Primary navigation, core content, and account state are visible. No major visual corruption is present.
riskSignals: Unity or Flutter surface renders black

steps.title: Run the highest-value business flow
steps.objective: Exercise the first business-critical flow from the smoke case list.
steps.action: Navigate from the home screen into the main smoke-test business flow. Complete the happy path without using voice input.
steps.expected: The flow reaches its success/complete state and returns to a stable screen.

steps.title: Voice recognition coverage gap
steps.objective: Document that this smoke area exists but is not automated by default.
steps.action: Do not execute unless an approved audio injection strategy is configured.
steps.expected: Skipped by automation and listed in the final report as manual/audio-fixture coverage.
riskSignals: Manual-only release blocker if voice is a launch-critical feature

steps.title: Return to stable state
steps.objective: Leave the device in a known state for the next run.
steps.action: Return to the home screen or a neutral screen. Do not log out unless the project requires fresh login on every smoke run.
steps.expected: The app remains responsive and ready for another test.
